name: 282. Bedrock tool result renders the same as a string or one text block (tool result rendering)
description: On the chat-completions path, convertToolMessages sent a tool message whose content was a string through tryParseJSONIntoContentBlock (JSON output became a Converse json block) but always sent the same text as a text block when the content was a one-element array of text blocks. OpenAI-compatible clients that set the cache breakpoint by sending only the last message as an array (so it can carry cache_control) send each tool result as a block on the turn it is last and as a string on later turns, so the rendering flipped from text to json between turns, the bytes before the earlier checkpoint changed, and Bedrock prompt caching missed on every turn of an agent loop. Case 1 pins the one-block form with cache_control: the toolResult carries a json object and the cachePoint still trails it (red before the fix: the content was {"text": ...}). Case 2 pins the string form producing the same json (parity baseline). Case 3 pins /v1/responses, whose function_call_output blocks already went through the same helper, so both neutral routes render identically. Each case reads the outbound Converse body via x-bf-send-back-raw-request.

item.name: 263.1 bedrock/claude-haiku-4-5 /v1/chat/completions one text block tool result with cache_control renders as json then cachePoint (tool result rendering)

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
var wire = JSON.stringify(rr || null);
// A tool result must render the same whether the client sent it as a string or as one
// text block: clients that mark only the last message with cache_control send it as a
// block on that turn and as a string afterwards, so a text/json flip breaks the cached prefix.
pm.test('263.1 bedrock/claude-haiku-4-5 /v1/chat/completions one text block tool result with cache_control renders as json then cachePoint (tool result rendering): request succeeds', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);

pm.test('263.1 bedrock/claude-haiku-4-5 /v1/chat/completions one text block tool result with cache_control renders as json then cachePoint (tool result rendering): toolResult carries the output as a json object', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
var content = null; var idx = -1;
(rr.messages || []).forEach(function (m) { (m.content || []).forEach(function (b, i) { if (b.toolResult && idx < 0) { content = m.content; idx = i; } }); });
pm.expect(idx, 'no toolResult block reached Converse: ' + wire.slice(0, 600)).to.be.at.least(0);
var inner = content[idx].toolResult.content || [];
pm.expect(inner.length, 'toolResult content: ' + JSON.stringify(inner)).to.eql(1);
pm.expect(inner[0].text, 'tool output was sent as a text block instead of json: ' + JSON.stringify(inner)).to.be.undefined;
pm.expect(inner[0].json, 'toolResult json altered: ' + JSON.stringify(inner)).to.eql({"files":["a","b"],"n":2});
var next = content[idx + 1] || {};
pm.expect(next.cachePoint, 'cache_control on the tool block was dropped - no cachePoint after the toolResult: ' + JSON.stringify(content).slice(0, 600)).to.be.an('object');
